body.statement: There are constants \(c_1,c_2,C,\zeta_0>0\), uniform over admissible interior centers, such that \(c_1\log(1/\varepsilon)\leq\lVert\ell_{\varepsilon,g_\star}\rVert_{L^2(P_{0g_\star})}^2\leq c_2\log(1/\varepsilon)\) and \(\lVert f_{0g_\star}\ell_{\varepsilon,g_\star}\rVert_{C^s}\leq C\varepsilon^{-s-1}\). For every fixed \(0<\zeta\leq\zeta_0\) satisfying \(C\zeta^2\leq\kappa\), the explicit laws from def:green-local-alternatives obey \(P_{n,+},P_{n,-}\in\mathcal F_s\cap\mathcal N_n(P_0,\kappa)\), \[\operatorname{Hel}^2\left(\bigotimes_{g\in\mathcal G}P_{n,+,g}^{\otimes n_g},\bigotimes_{g\in\mathcal G}P_{n,-,g}^{\otimes n_g}\right)\leq C\zeta^2\leq1/2,\] and \[\left|\upsilon^{\mathsf T}\{\tau(P_{n,+})-\tau(P_{n,-})\}_1\right|\geq c_1\zeta\sqrt{\frac{\log(1/\varepsilon_n)}{n}}.\] The restriction \(\eta<1/[2(s+1)]\) makes the \(C^s\) perturbation \(O(n^{-1/2}\varepsilon_n^{-s-1}/\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon_n)})\) vanish, and perturbing the cell with \(n_{g_\star}=n\) makes the product-Hellinger bound independent of the other cell-size ratios. For each sign, write \(p\) and \(T\) for the inner and outer optimal maps evaluated at \(P_{n,\pm}\), with translations and potentials selected by \(\operatorname{Lift}_{\mathbb T}\). Causal-class membership is witnessed constructively by \(h_0=\operatorname{id}\), \(\nu_C=P_{n,\pm,C0}\), \(\nu_T=P_{n,\pm,T0}\), \(h_1=p\), and \(h_{1\star}=T^{-1}\circ p\); torus optimal-transport uniqueness makes the two required compositions \(c_{\mathbb T}\)-cyclically monotone. The vanishing \(C^s\) perturbation and interior margins imply that \(p\), \(T\), and \(T^{-1}\circ p\) remain diffeomorphisms, preserve the ellipticity bounds, remain on the same half-open lift branches, and stay a fixed positive distance from the squared-distance cut locus for all sufficiently large \(n\). Moreover \(\lVert a_p(P_{n,\pm})-a_p(P_0)\rVert+\lVert a_T(P_{n,\pm})-a_T(P_0)\rVert=O(n^{-1/2})\); thus the harmonic translation changes are negligible relative to the Green separation \(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon_n)/n}\).
body.justification: The lemma audits the converse through a named annular Green tangent, normalized alternatives, class membership, bounded product-experiment distance, and a quantitative estimand separation.
body.gap: The single-scale Fano perturbations in HutterRigollet2021Minimax control global map loss but do not accumulate the pointwise logarithm or coordinate four unequal samples through product Hellinger distance.
body.consumer: The explicit two-point experiment turns the critical logarithm into a checkable information bound for the nested displacement rather than a heuristic variance analogy.
